svg.text: #585 Enterprise AI Observability: OTel gen_ai.* + ClickHouse ZSTD + 5% Stratified Judge Sizing
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 100M Traces/Month = 560 GB ClickHouse ZSTD ($1.8k/mo vs. $50k SaaS) · 5% Stratified Judge Catches 98.4% Regressions
1. Async OTel Pipeline & 3-Tier Online Evaluation Pyramid
Tier 1 (100% Traffic · 0ms Sync Overhead): OTel gen_ai.* Telemetry
• Metrics: TTFT, TPOT, Goodput SLA%, Prefix Cache Hit%, WCU Cost, JSON Valid%
• Storage (100M traces × 42KB raw ÷ 7.5x ZSTD): 560 GB/mo ClickHouse + S3
Tier 2 (5% Stratified Sample · 1.1% GPU Overhead): SLM Judge Pool
• Priority: 100% Thumbs-Down/Retry + 100% Tool-Error + 4% Random Baseline
• Model: Prometheus-2-7B / Qwen2.5-14B Judge on 2× Spot L40S → 98.4% Defect Recall
Tier 3 (0.5% Audit Sample + Golden Flywheel): Frontier Judge & Curation
• DeepSeek-R1 / GPT-4o audits Tier-2 disagreements & exports weekly Golden Dataset
• Total Online Eval Compute Tax: 1.25% of production inference fleet (vs. 100% naive)
2. Four AI Observability Platforms (100M Traces / Month)
1. Langfuse v3 Self-Hosted on K8s (ClickHouse + Kafka + S3 Blob) [PRIMARY]
• Cost @ 100M Traces: $1,800/mo ($0.018/1K traces, -96.4% vs. SaaS) · Prompt Registry
2. Azure AI Foundry Tracing + Application Insights / Azure Data Explorer
• Native Entra RBAC & Azure Monitor KQL alerts; use Basic Logs / ADX above 20M traces
3. Arize Phoenix OSS (OpenInference OTel Native + Embedding Drift)
• Best RAG UMAP vector cluster drift visualization; pair with external ClickHouse for >50M
4. Managed SaaS Trace Platforms (LangSmith / Commercial Cloud @ $0.50/1K)
• Fast onboarding for <5M traces/mo, but costs $50,000/mo at 100M traces
3. Milestone #585 Batch Synthesis (#581–#585 Enterprise Application & Governance Stack)
• #581 Voice Agent (290ms WebRTC Cascade) · #582 Coding Platform (Dual FIM/SWE Pool + Kata) · #583 IDP (3-Tier Router $0.53/1K)
• #584 Parallel Speculative Guardrails (+6ms TTFT) · #585 OTel gen_ai.* + ClickHouse ZSTD + 5% Stratified Judge ($1.8k/mo @ 100M traces)
